newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: German takes life by flying into mountain - agency.
newsitem.headline: German takes life by flying into mountain - agency.

text.p: A German man committed suicide on Sunday by flying his single motor Piper aircraft at full speed into the Zugspitze mountain range on Austria's border with Germany, the Austrian news agency APA reported.

Security officials in the area said 55-year-old Udo Berninghaus from Puettlingen in the south-western state of Saarland, made clear his intention of suicide after taking off from nearby Saarbruecken on the German-French border, APA said.
The police tried to talk him down via radio while tailing him by helicopter, but to no avail. They saw the aircraft crash into the mountain and explode in Austria's western province of Tyrol.
His motive for suicide was unknown.
